theCreativeDreamer.title: The Creative Dreamer
theCreativeDreamer.description: A passionate idealist with an endless stream of big questions and ideas to consider. Comfortable with their head in the clouds.

theDiscriminatingIdeator.title: The Discriminating Ideator
theDiscriminatingIdeator.description: A creative, intuitive, and confident generator of new ideas. Uses instinct and integrative thinking to solve real problems.

theInsightfulCollaborator.title: The Insightful Collaborator
theInsightfulCollaborator.description: An intuitive, empathic advisor and team player. Selfless and compassionate in providing others with what they need in the right way.

theContemplativeCounselor.title: The Contemplative Counselor
theContemplativeCounselor.description: A thoughtful, insightful, and nuanced advisor. Slow to declare certainty but deep in wisdom, intuition, and rationale.

theEvangelizingInnovator.title: The Evangelizing Innovator
theEvangelizingInnovator.description: An excitable and convincing generator and promoter of new ideas. Combines curiosity and confidence with infectious enthusiasm.

theJudiciousAccomplisher.title: The Judicious Accomplisher
theJudiciousAccomplisher.description: A reliable, prudent, and focused doer. A unique combination of practical urgency and intuitive judgment.

thePhilosophicalMotivator.title: The Philosophical Motivator
thePhilosophicalMotivator.description: An excitable, curious, and enthusiastic proponent of ideas and people. A unique combination of eagerness and caution.

theAdaptableDesigner.title: The Adaptable Designer
theAdaptableDesigner.description: A generator of new ideas in response to the needs of others. A unique combination of creativity and flexibility.

theEnthusiasticEncourager.title: The Enthusiastic Encourager
theEnthusiasticEncourager.description: A warm and positive affirmer of others. Quick to support and inspire people who need energy or reassurance.

theIdealisticSupporter.title: The Idealistic Supporter
theIdealisticSupporter.description: A loyal, modest, and thoughtful contributor. Carefully considers others’ needs and reluctant to demand attention.

theMethodicalArchitect.title: The Methodical Architect
theMethodicalArchitect.description: A precise, reliable, and planful solver of problems. A unique combination of innovative thinking and practical implementation.

theAssertiveDriver.title: The Assertive Driver
theAssertiveDriver.description: A taskmaster extraordinaire. Willing to push and remind others, and dive in themselves, to ensure that things get done.

theCarefulImplementer.title: The Careful Implementer
theCarefulImplementer.description: A thorough, practical, and careful contributor. A unique combination of steady reliability and quiet depth.

theIntuitiveActivator.title: The Intuitive Activator
theIntuitiveActivator.description: An instinctive and confident decision-maker. Able to assess situations quickly and accurately, and marshal people to act.

theLoyalFinisher.title: The Loyal Finisher
theLoyalFinisher.description: A responsive, dependable doer. Willing to step up when something is needed and determined to fulfill their commitments.
